rv.q: In the BLO’s current production, Grammy Award-winning soprano Brittany Renee all but blows the roof off the Emerson Cutler Majestic with her powerfully pure vocals and a shatteringly on-point dramatic portrayal that eschews Blanche’s physical fragility and instead focuses on the emotional frailty deep within the character.
In the case of Previn’s Streetcar , just three hours of awkward, atmosphere-less languor.
Ultimately, this production gives us the exact magic Tennessee Williams envisioned, and Previn so brilliantly scored.

cn.t: Critics praise this BLO/Opera Theatre of Saint Louis co-production of Previn's operatic *Streetcar*, calling it stunning and emotionally resonant. Scores averaging 85/100 reflect a strong, enthusiastic reception.
